summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private. Evidence: official Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not rights to store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, or monetize returned data; current terms point against those uses. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is configured for 39 sites, but permission/source errors remain. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission, $0 site-attributed; this does not establish zero site performance. Security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when existing consent, cookie and analytics disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright/trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards are preserved. Do not add tracking, expand monetization, publish rights-dependent content, make unsupported claims, or expose the private product.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for official source documentation and terms, backend/api/main.py, backend/services/fetcher.py, config.yml, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Open tasks remain source rights, alert-data retention and user workflows, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; caching, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising limits. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator and vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Checklist review: analytics incompleteness is not a general growth blocker; do not treat unavailable sources as zero. Revenue attribution remains partial because the provider aggregate row cannot be assigned to a site. Claims, affiliate disclosures, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive or regulated concerns remain site- and content-specific; no clearance is supported where evidence is absent. Private or gated sites require an explicit keep-private decision and completed launch checklist before exposure.
Maintain the private launch gate and continue the existing read-only checklist. Keep the prepared permission request unsent pending human-counsel review and explicit owner authorization.
